source.exampleRuntimeAuditMethod: Per-variant local docs preview: bring each preview into view; inspect Web Animations, computed animation/transition styles, SVG attribute values, and canvas frame fingerprints; apply profile-matched pointer-sweep/hover/click/press-and-hold/drag/scroll input where indicated; capture before, activation, and follow-up frames.
